gloss: to exploit someone's weakness; to take advantage of a vulnerability

definitions.gloss: to exploit someone's weakness; to take advantage of a vulnerability
definitions.explanation: To take unfair advantage of another person's vulnerable position, difficult circumstances, or shortcomings for one's own benefit. Always carries a negative, morally critical connotation.

examples.japanese: {人|ひと}の{弱|よわ}みに{付|つ}け{込|こ}むな。
{悪徳|あくとく}{業者|ぎょうしゃ}は{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}の{弱|よわ}みに{付|つ}け{込|こ}む。
examples.english: Unscrupulous businesses exploit the vulnerabilities of the elderly.

examples.japanese: {相手|あいて}の{弱|よわ}みに{付|つ}け{込|こ}んで{交渉|こうしょう}を{有利|ゆうり}に{進|すす}めた。
examples.english: He exploited the other party's weakness to steer the negotiations in his favor.

examples.japanese: {困|こま}っている{人|ひと}の{弱|よわ}みに{付|つ}け{込|こ}むのは{卑怯|ひきょう}だ。
examples.english: It's cowardly to exploit the weakness of someone in trouble.

notes:
An idiomatic expression meaning to take unfair advantage of someone's vulnerable position. Always carries a negative connotation — it implies underhanded or morally questionable behavior.

USAGE:
The person whose weakness is being exploited is marked with の:
- {人|ひと}の{弱|よわ}みに{付|つ}け{込|こ}む
- {相手|あいて}の{弱|よわ}みに{付|つ}け{込|こ}む

{付|つ}け{込|こ}む is a godan verb ({込|こ}む conjugation), so the expression conjugates at the end: {付|つ}け{込|こ}んだ, {付|つ}け{込|こ}まない, etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人|ひと}の{弱|よわ}みに{付|つ}け{込|こ}む: to exploit someone's weakness
- {相手|あいて}の{弱|よわ}みに{付|つ}け{込|こ}む: to take advantage of the opponent's vulnerability
- {立場|たちば}の{弱|よわ}みに{付|つ}け{込|こ}む: to exploit someone's weak position

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {足元|あしもと}を{見|み}る: to take advantage of someone's situation — implies sizing up someone's weakness for exploitation
- {漬|つ}け{込|こ}む: to exploit (older kanji variant) — same pronunciation but different kanji; the {付|つ}け{込|こ}む form is standard here
- {利用|りよう}する: to take advantage of — more neutral, can be positive or negative
